question.text: Two vectors <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>A</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mi> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">a</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">d</mi><mi> </mi><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>B</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math> are defined as <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>A</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mi>a</mi><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>i</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover><mi> </mi><mi>a</mi><mi>n</mi><mi>d</mi><mi> </mi><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>B</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mi>a</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">cos</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mi>ω</mi><mi>t</mi><mi> </mi><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>i</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">sin</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mi>ω</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow></mrow><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>j</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover></mrow></mrow></mrow></mfenced></math>, where a is a constant and <math><mi>ω</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>π</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>6</mn></mrow></mfrac><mi> </mi><mi>r</mi><mi>a</mi><mi>d</mi><mi> </mi><msup><mrow><mi>s</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo>.</mo></math> If <math><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mrow><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>A</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>B</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></mrow></mfenced><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mn>3</mn></msqrt><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mrow><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>A</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>-</mo><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>B</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></mrow></mfenced></math> at time <math><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>τ</mi></math> for the first time, the value of <math><mi>τ</mi></math> in seconds, is_______

solution.text:
A→+B→=2 acos⁡ωt2
A→-B→=2asin⁡ωt2
So 2acos⁡ωt2=32asin⁡ωt2
tan⁡ωt2=13
ωt2=π6⇒ωt=π3
π6t=π3
t=2.00 sec
